title: SkillsCarryOverReport

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

dryRun.description: Whether it was a dry run: the report of what a run would do, with nothing written.

kind.description: What a member is: skill, a folder holding SKILL.md; or command, a Markdown file in the own directory's commands/, named by its file.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

from.description: Where the original lies: a folder or command file in the adopted directory's skills/ or commands/, or in the machine's ~/.agents/skills.

path.description: Its path in the own directory: where it was copied to, skills/<folder> or commands/<file>; for one kept, the path of what the own directory already holds under its name.

items.description: An original skill folder or command file Carry over copied into the own directory, or kept out of it because the own directory already holds its name.

copied.description: The originals copied into the own directory (in a dry run, those that would be); its length is the count.

kind.description: What a member is: skill, a folder holding SKILL.md; or command, a Markdown file in the own directory's commands/, named by its file.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

from.description: Where the original lies: a folder or command file in the adopted directory's skills/ or commands/, or in the machine's ~/.agents/skills.

path.description: Its path in the own directory: where it was copied to, skills/<folder> or commands/<file>; for one kept, the path of what the own directory already holds under its name.

items.description: An original skill folder or command file Carry over copied into the own directory, or kept out of it because the own directory already holds its name.

kept.description: The valid originals not copied because the own directory already holds their name; its length is the count.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

from.description: Where the skill folder was found: in the adopted directory's skills/, or in the machine's ~/.agents/skills.

url.description: The working tree's remote, as git expands it, stripped of any credential.

folder.description: The skill folder's path in the repository, from its root; . when the folder is the repository's root.

anyOf.description: A branch a skill source follows, as git takes a branch name: 1 to 255 characters with no white space, control character or any of ~ ^ : ? * [ \, no .. or @{, no empty segment, none beginning with . or ending with .lock, no trailing / or ., not @, and not beginning with -.

branch.description: The branch; null for the remote's default branch, the one its HEAD names.

oneOf.description: A branch the source syncs from, at start, every six hours and on Pull now.

commit.description: A git commit's full object name: 40 lowercase hexadecimal digits, or 64 in a SHA-256 repository.

oneOf.description: A commit the source is pinned to: it never syncs until it is unpinned.

follow.description: The branch the working tree is on (its upstream's on the remote, else the local one), or a pin at its commit when HEAD is detached.

items.description: A skill folder inside a git working tree with a remote, offered as a skill source instead of copied: the URL, folder and follow skills.sources.add takes.

offered.description: The skill folders inside a git working tree with a remote, offered as sources and not copied; its length is the count.

kind.description: What a member is: skill, a folder holding SKILL.md; or command, a Markdown file in the own directory's commands/, named by its file.

anyOf.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

name.description: Its name by the member-naming rule; null when none passes, a name problem saying why.

kind.description: What is wrong: frontmatter (its frontmatter does not read as a YAML mapping, so nothing in it is taken), name (neither its frontmatter name nor its folder's or file's name passes the skill-name rule) or description (its frontmatter has no description, which the Agent Skills spec requires).

message.description: What is wrong, for people: the names tried and why each fails.

items.description: A problem that leaves a member invalid: it is listed with the problem and left out of the skill set.

problems.description: What leaves it invalid, as the own directory's reader would list it.

items.description: An original skill folder or command file that reads as invalid, with its problems: neither copied nor offered.

invalid.description: The originals that read as invalid, with their problems, left where they are; its length is the count.

kind.description: What it is: subagent, a Markdown file in the adopted directory's agents/; plugin, an installed plugin its plugins/ lists.

name.description: Its name: a subagent's file name without .md; a plugin's as its installed list names it, name@marketplace.

items.description: A subagent or plugin in the adopted directory, which Carry over does not carry.

notCarried.description: The adopted directory's subagents and plugins, which are not carried.

description: What Carry over's skills half did, or in a dry run would do: the originals copied into the own directory, kept out of it, offered as sources and invalid, and the subagents and plugins not carried.
